ToneOptions.Label: Proactive & Strategic
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a proactive, strategic, and forward-thinking tone, emphasizing foresight and business value.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven & Analytical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a data-driven, analytical, and technically precise tone, focusing on ML and operational metrics.

ToneOptions.Label: Risk-Mitigating & Resilient
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Convey a risk-mitigating and resilience-focused tone, highlighting incident prevention and service continuity.

ToneOptions.Label: Efficient & Optimized
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Use an efficient and optimized tone, stressing streamlined operations and resource utilization.

GoalOptions.Label: Minimize Downtime
GoalOptions.Text: Achieve a significant reduction in critical IT incidents and associated downtime. Ensure uninterrupted service delivery and maintain high availability for all business-critical applications and infrastructure. This directly supports revenue generation and customer satisfaction.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Operational Efficiency
GoalOptions.Text: Streamline IT operations by automating incident detection and enabling proactive remediation. Reduce manual intervention and MTTR, freeing up valuable engineering resources for innovation and strategic projects. This leads to cost savings and improved team productivity.

GoalOptions.Label: Improve Predictability
GoalOptions.Text: Establish a predictable IT environment by accurately forecasting potential failures before they occur. Increase confidence in system stability and performance, allowing for better capacity planning and resource allocation. This fosters a more stable and reliable IT landscape.

GoalOptions.Label: Reduce Operational Costs
GoalOptions.Text: Lower overall IT operational expenditures by preventing costly incidents and reducing the need for emergency fixes. Optimize resource utilization and minimize the impact of unforeseen events on the bottom line. This demonstrates a clear return on investment for IT operations.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Impact
Criteria: Quantifiable reduction in incident-related revenue loss.
Demonstrable decrease in operational expenditure due to proactive measures.
Improved customer satisfaction scores linked to service uptime.
Clear ROI projection based on incident avoidance and resource optimization.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Performance
Criteria: Accuracy and precision of predictive incident detection models.
Reduction in Mean Time To Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time To Resolve (MTTR) for predicted incidents.
Successful integration with existing IT monitoring and logging tools.
Scalability and performance of the AIOps platform under peak load.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Resilience
Criteria: Percentage reduction in unplanned outages impacting critical business services.
Effectiveness of automated remediation workflows triggered by predictive alerts.
Improved visibility into potential failure points across the IT landscape.
Adherence to ITIL or similar frameworks for incident management and service continuity.
